```{r}
# 2. Set a new working directory (always use forward slashes, even on Windows)
setwd("/Users/madelina/Desktop/spaciotemp.git")
getwd()
```

This file holds the 16S preprocessing for all three experiments, from raw
`_R1/_R2_16S_final.fastq` files to cleaned phyloseq objects:

1. **Internal / External (Chapter 1)**: one MiSeq run, one error model.
2. **Seasonal mats (SM)**: samples come from **two MiSeq runs** (10828 and
   11002), so DADA2 learns a **separate error model for each run**. This section
   replaces the earlier SM processing, which pooled both runs into one error
   model. It also runs one sample at a time and saves every result, so it can
   resume after a crash on a laptop.
3. **Diel**: one run, one error model.

All three use the same settings: primers 515F/806R (already removed),
`truncLen = c(220, 220)`, `maxEE = c(2, 2)`, `minOverlap = 12`,
`maxMismatch = 0`, merged length 245-265 bp, consensus chimera removal,
SILVA v138.1, and prevalence-based decontam (threshold 0.5). Rarefaction is not used at this time..

**Running this file.** Many steps take 20-60+ minutes and use a lot of memory,
so chunks are set to `eval = FALSE` and the file knits as a code record. Run
chunks interactively in order, or set `eval = TRUE` below.

**Folder layout** (relative to this file; raw data and SILVA are not in the repo):

```
fastqfiles/        internal/external fastqs
fastqfiles_sm/     seasonal mat fastqs
fastqfiles_diel/   diel fastqs
silva_nr99_v138.1_train_set.fa
silva_species_assignment_v138.1.fa.gz
Metadata_CH1_IE.csv, SM_SAMDF4.csv, DIEL_SAMDF.csv
```

```{r setup, include = FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(eval = FALSE)   # set to TRUE to run everything on knit
```

# 0. Shared setup

```{r install}
# Only needed once
if (!requireNamespace("BiocManager", quietly = TRUE)) install.packages("BiocManager")
BiocManager::install(c("dada2", "ShortRead", "Biostrings", "phyloseq", "decontam"))
```

```{r libraries}
library(dada2); packageVersion("dada2")
library(ShortRead)
library(Biostrings)
library(phyloseq)
library(decontam)
library(ggplot2)
```

```{r paths}
ie_path       <- "fastqfiles"        # internal/external
sm_path       <- "fastqfiles_sm"     # seasonal mats
diel_path     <- "fastqfiles_diel"   # diel
silva         <- "silva_nr99_v138.1_train_set.fa"
silva_species <- "silva_species_assignment_v138.1.fa.gz"
stopifnot(file.exists(silva))
```

## Primers and helper functions (used by all three experiments)

```{r primers}
FWD <- "GTGYCAGCMGCCGCGGTAA"    # 515F
REV <- "GGACTACNVGGGTWTCTAAT"   # 806R

# All orientations of a primer
allOrients <- function(primer) {
  dna <- DNAString(primer)
  orients <- c(Forward = dna, Complement = complement(dna),
               Reverse = reverse(dna), RevComp = reverseComplement(dna))
  sapply(orients, toString)
}
FWD.orients <- allOrients(FWD)
REV.orients <- allOrients(REV)

# Number of reads in which a primer is found (want 0 everywhere)
primerHits <- function(primer, fn) {
  nhits <- vcountPattern(primer, sread(readFastq(fn)), fixed = FALSE)
  sum(nhits > 0)
}
primerTable <- function(fnF, fnR) {
  rbind(FWD.ForwardReads = sapply(FWD.orients, primerHits, fn = fnF),
        FWD.ReverseReads = sapply(FWD.orients, primerHits, fn = fnR),
        REV.ForwardReads = sapply(REV.orients, primerHits, fn = fnF),
        REV.ReverseReads = sapply(REV.orients, primerHits, fn = fnR))
}

# Quality profiles in groups of 10 samples
plotQualityGroups <- function(files, size = 10) {
  for (i in seq(1, length(files), by = size)) {
    print(plotQualityProfile(files[i:min(i + size - 1, length(files))]))
  }
}

getN <- function(x) sum(getUniques(x))
```

---

# 1. Internal / External (Chapter 1)

## 1.1 Files and sample names

The sample name is the 3rd `_`-separated part of the file name (e.g.
`MM_IE_D1_R1...` becomes `D1`). The negative control file `G8_R1_16S_final.fastq`
becomes `"16S"`, and that name is used to find it in decontam below.

```{r ie-files}
fnFs.ie <- sort(list.files(ie_path, pattern = "_R1_16S_final.fastq", full.names = TRUE))
fnRs.ie <- sort(list.files(ie_path, pattern = "_R2_16S_final.fastq", full.names = TRUE))
sample.names.ie <- unname(sapply(fnFs.ie, function(f) strsplit(basename(f), "_")[[1]][3]))
sample.names.ie
```

## 1.2 Remove reads with Ns (filtN) and check for primers

```{r ie-filtN}
fnFs.filtN.ie <- file.path(ie_path, "filtN", basename(fnFs.ie))
fnRs.filtN.ie <- file.path(ie_path, "filtN", basename(fnRs.ie))
filterAndTrim(fnFs.ie, fnFs.filtN.ie, fnRs.ie, fnRs.filtN.ie,
              maxN = 0, multithread = TRUE, compress = TRUE)

primerTable(fnFs.filtN.ie[[4]], fnRs.filtN.ie[[4]])   # all 0: no primers
```

## 1.3 Quality profiles

```{r ie-qc}
plotQualityGroups(fnFs.filtN.ie)
plotQualityGroups(fnRs.filtN.ie)
# Quality holds up well to 220 bp -> truncLen = c(220, 220)
```

## 1.4 Filter and trim

```{r ie-trim}
filtFs.ie <- file.path(ie_path, "trimmed", paste0(sample.names.ie, "_F_filt.fastq.gz"))
filtRs.ie <- file.path(ie_path, "trimmed", paste0(sample.names.ie, "_R_filt.fastq.gz"))

out.ie <- filterAndTrim(fnFs.ie, filtFs.ie, fnRs.ie, filtRs.ie,
                        truncLen = c(220, 220), maxN = 0, maxEE = c(2, 2),
                        truncQ = 2, rm.phix = TRUE, matchIDs = TRUE,
                        compress = TRUE, multithread = TRUE)
head(out.ie)
write.csv(out.ie, "out.csv", row.names = TRUE, quote = FALSE)
```

## 1.5 Error rates

```{r ie-errors}
setDadaOpt(MAX_CONSIST = 30)   # more iterations to let the error model converge
errF.ie <- learnErrors(filtFs.ie, multithread = TRUE)
errR.ie <- learnErrors(filtRs.ie, multithread = TRUE)
plotErrors(errF.ie, nominalQ = TRUE)
plotErrors(errR.ie, nominalQ = TRUE)
setDadaOpt(MAX_CONSIST = 10)   # back to the default for the SM and diel sections
```

## 1.6 Dereplicate, denoise, merge

```{r ie-dada}
derepFs.ie <- derepFastq(filtFs.ie, verbose = TRUE)
derepRs.ie <- derepFastq(filtRs.ie, verbose = TRUE)
names(derepFs.ie) <- sample.names.ie
names(derepRs.ie) <- sample.names.ie

dadaFs.ie <- dada(derepFs.ie, err = errF.ie, multithread = TRUE)
dadaRs.ie <- dada(derepRs.ie, err = errR.ie, multithread = TRUE)

mergers.ie <- mergePairs(dadaFs.ie, derepFs.ie, dadaRs.ie, derepRs.ie,
                         minOverlap = 12, maxMismatch = 0, verbose = TRUE)
```

## 1.7 Sequence table, length filter, chimeras

```{r ie-seqtab}
seqtab.ie <- makeSequenceTable(mergers.ie)
saveRDS(seqtab.ie, "seqtab_ch1_ie_16S.rds")
table(nchar(getSequences(seqtab.ie)))

seqtab2.ie <- seqtab.ie[, nchar(colnames(seqtab.ie)) %in% 245:265]
saveRDS(seqtab2.ie, "seqtab2_ch1_ie_16S.rds")

seqtab.nochim.ie <- removeBimeraDenovo(seqtab2.ie, method = "consensus",
                                       multithread = TRUE, verbose = TRUE)
dim(seqtab.nochim.ie)                       # previous run: 25 x 15785
sum(seqtab.nochim.ie) / sum(seqtab2.ie)     # previous run: 0.962
saveRDS(seqtab.nochim.ie, "seqtab.nochim_ch1_ie_16S.rds")
```

## 1.8 Read tracking

```{r ie-track}
track.ie <- cbind(out.ie, sapply(dadaFs.ie, getN), sapply(mergers.ie, getN),
                  rowSums(seqtab2.ie), rowSums(seqtab.nochim.ie))
colnames(track.ie) <- c("input", "filtered", "denoised", "merged", "tabled", "nonchim")
rownames(track.ie) <- sample.names.ie
write.csv(track.ie, "CH1_IE_2025_16S_readstats.csv", row.names = TRUE, quote = FALSE)
```

## 1.9 Taxonomy

`addSpecies` needs more memory than a laptop has. It was run on the lab tower /
OnDemand R session using the saved `taxa` object. ~ not enough classification at this taxonomic rank

```{r ie-taxa}
taxa.ie <- assignTaxonomy(seqtab.nochim.ie, silva, multithread = TRUE)
saveRDS(taxa.ie, "CH1_IE_2025_16S_taxa.rds")

taxa.plus.ie <- addSpecies(taxa.ie, silva_species, tryRC = TRUE, verbose = TRUE)
saveRDS(taxa.plus.ie, "CH1_IE_2025_16S_taxa.plus.rds")
```

## 1.10 Phyloseq, cleaning, decontam

```{r ie-phyloseq}
samdf.ie <- read.csv("Metadata_CH1_IE.csv")
rownames(samdf.ie) <- samdf.ie$Sample
stopifnot(setequal(rownames(samdf.ie), rownames(seqtab.nochim.ie)))

# Short ASV names; keep the sequence as an extra taxonomy column
ids.ie   <- paste0("sq", seq_len(ncol(seqtab.nochim.ie)))
taxa2.ie <- cbind(taxa.plus.ie, Sequence = rownames(taxa.plus.ie))
colnames(seqtab.nochim.ie) <- ids.ie
rownames(taxa2.ie) <- ids.ie

ps.ie <- phyloseq(otu_table(seqtab.nochim.ie, taxa_are_rows = FALSE),
                  sample_data(samdf.ie), tax_table(taxa2.ie))
saveRDS(ps.ie, "ch1_ie_ps.rds")

# Remove mitochondria, chloroplasts, non-bacteria
ps.clean.ie <- subset_taxa(ps.ie, (Family != "Mitochondria") | is.na(Family))
ps.clean.ie <- subset_taxa(ps.clean.ie, (Order != "Chloroplast") | is.na(Order))
ps.clean.ie <- subset_taxa(ps.clean.ie, Kingdom == "Bacteria")
saveRDS(ps.clean.ie, "ch1_ie_psclean.rds")

# Library sizes (negative control should be lowest)
df <- as.data.frame(sample_data(ps.clean.ie))
df$LibrarySize <- sample_sums(ps.clean.ie)
df <- df[order(df$LibrarySize), ]; df$Index <- seq(nrow(df))
ggplot(df, aes(Index, LibrarySize, color = Sample.Type)) + geom_point()

# Decontam (negative control = "16S")
sample_data(ps.clean.ie)$is.neg <- sample_names(ps.clean.ie) == "16S"
contam.ie <- isContaminant(ps.clean.ie, method = "prevalence",
                           neg = "is.neg", threshold = 0.5)
table(contam.ie$contaminant)                # previous run: 6 contaminants

ps.cleaner.ie <- prune_taxa(!contam.ie$contaminant, ps.clean.ie)
ps.cleaner.ie <- prune_samples(sample_names(ps.cleaner.ie) != "16S", ps.cleaner.ie)
ps.cleaner.ie                               # previous run: 14162 taxa, 24 samples
saveRDS(ps.cleaner.ie, "CH1_IE_16S_ps.cleaner.RDS")   # USED FOR STATS
```

# 2. Seasonal mats (corrected: one error model per MiSeq run)

- Run 10828 = seasonal samples before August 2024 (`MM_SM_*`)
- Run 11002 = August 2024 (`MM_A24SM_*`) + Summer 2025 (`MM_J25SM_*`)

Each sample is denoised on its own. That gives the same result as `dada()` on
all samples together, because the default is `pool = FALSE`. Every result is
saved to `SM_byrun_checkpoints/`. If R crashes, restart and run again: samples
that are already done are skipped.

## 2.1 Remove reads with Ns (filtN), primer check, quality profiles

```{r sm-filtN}
fnFs.sm <- sort(list.files(sm_path, pattern = "_R1_16S_final.fastq", full.names = TRUE))
fnRs.sm <- sort(list.files(sm_path, pattern = "_R2_16S_final.fastq", full.names = TRUE))
length(fnFs.sm)                             # want 77

fnFs.filtN.sm <- file.path(sm_path, "filtN", basename(fnFs.sm))
fnRs.filtN.sm <- file.path(sm_path, "filtN", basename(fnRs.sm))
for (i in seq(1, length(fnFs.sm), by = 5)) {          # chunks of 5 to save memory
  inds <- i:min(i + 4, length(fnFs.sm))
  inds <- inds[!file.exists(fnFs.filtN.sm[inds])]     # skip finished files
  if (length(inds)) filterAndTrim(fnFs.sm[inds], fnFs.filtN.sm[inds],
                                  fnRs.sm[inds], fnRs.filtN.sm[inds],
                                  maxN = 0, multithread = TRUE, compress = TRUE)
}

primerTable(fnFs.filtN.sm[[4]], fnRs.filtN.sm[[4]])   # all 0: no primers

plotQualityGroups(fnFs.filtN.sm)
plotQualityGroups(fnRs.filtN.sm)
# truncLen = c(220, 220)
```

## 2.2 Filter and trim (only samples whose trimmed files are missing)

```{r sm-trim}
trim_path  <- file.path(sm_path, "trimmed")
outsm_file <- "outsm.csv"                   # filterAndTrim read counts
samdf_file <- "SM_SAMDF4.csv"               # corrected metadata
ckpt       <- "SM_byrun_checkpoints"
dir.create(trim_path, showWarnings = FALSE)
dir.create(ckpt, showWarnings = FALSE)

fnF <- fnFs.sm
fnR <- fnRs.sm
sample.names <- sub("_R1_16S_final.fastq.*$", "", basename(fnF))
stopifnot(identical(sample.names, sub("_R2_16S_final.fastq.*$", "", basename(fnR))))

filtF <- file.path(trim_path, paste0(sample.names, "_F_filt.fastq.gz"))
filtR <- file.path(trim_path, paste0(sample.names, "_R_filt.fastq.gz"))
names(filtF) <- sample.names
names(filtR) <- sample.names

todo <- which(!file.exists(filtF) | !file.exists(filtR))
message(length(todo), " samples need filterAndTrim")
for (i in todo) {
  o <- filterAndTrim(fnF[i], filtF[i], fnR[i], filtR[i],
                     truncLen = c(220, 220), maxN = 0, maxEE = c(2, 2),
                     truncQ = 2, rm.phix = TRUE, matchIDs = TRUE,
                     compress = TRUE, multithread = TRUE)
  saveRDS(o, file.path(ckpt, paste0("filt_", sample.names[i], ".rds")))
}

# Input/filtered read counts for tracking
if (file.exists(outsm_file)) {
  outsm <- read.csv(outsm_file, row.names = 1)
  rownames(outsm) <- sub("_R1_16S_final.fastq.*$", "", rownames(outsm))
} else {
  outsm <- matrix(NA_real_, nrow = length(sample.names), ncol = 2,
                  dimnames = list(sample.names, c("reads.in", "reads.out")))
  for (s in sample.names) {
    f <- file.path(ckpt, paste0("filt_", s, ".rds"))
    if (file.exists(f)) outsm[s, ] <- readRDS(f)[1, ]
  }
  message("outsm file not found: input/filtered counts are NA for reused trimmed files")
}
head(outsm)

# Samples that lost every read in filtering cannot be denoised
keep <- file.exists(filtF) & file.exists(filtR)
filtF <- filtF[keep]; filtR <- filtR[keep]; sample.names <- sample.names[keep]
```

## 2.3 Assign runs

```{r sm-runs}
run <- rep(NA_character_, length(sample.names))
run[grepl("^MM_SM_", sample.names)]               <- "R10828"
run[grepl("^MM_A24SM_|^MM_J25SM_", sample.names)] <- "R11002"
run[sample.names == "MM_NEG_F4"]  <- "R11002"   # CONFIRM: negative on run 11002
run[sample.names == "MM_NEG_H12"] <- "R10828"   # CONFIRM: negative on run 10828
names(run) <- sample.names
print(table(run, useNA = "ifany"))
stopifnot(!any(is.na(run)))
```

## 2.4 Error models, one per run (~20-40 min each; saved once)

```{r sm-errors}
for (r in unique(run)) {
  f <- file.path(ckpt, paste0("err_", r, ".rds"))
  if (file.exists(f)) next
  set.seed(100)
  errF <- learnErrors(filtF[run == r], multithread = TRUE, randomize = TRUE)
  errR <- learnErrors(filtR[run == r], multithread = TRUE, randomize = TRUE)
  saveRDS(list(errF = errF, errR = errR), f)
  rm(errF, errR); gc()
}

pdf("SM_error_plots_by_run.pdf")
for (r in unique(run)) {
  e <- readRDS(file.path(ckpt, paste0("err_", r, ".rds")))
  print(plotErrors(e$errF, nominalQ = TRUE) + ggtitle(paste(r, "forward")))
  print(plotErrors(e$errR, nominalQ = TRUE) + ggtitle(paste(r, "reverse")))
}
dev.off()
```

## 2.5 Denoise and merge, one sample at a time (resumable)

```{r sm-dada}
err <- lapply(setNames(unique(run), unique(run)),
              function(r) readRDS(file.path(ckpt, paste0("err_", r, ".rds"))))

for (s in sample.names) {
  f <- file.path(ckpt, paste0("merged_", s, ".rds"))
  if (file.exists(f)) next
  message("Denoising ", s, " (", run[s], ")  ",
          which(sample.names == s), " of ", length(sample.names))
  e  <- err[[run[s]]]
  dF <- dada(filtF[[s]], err = e$errF, multithread = TRUE)
  dR <- dada(filtR[[s]], err = e$errR, multithread = TRUE)
  mg <- mergePairs(dF, filtF[[s]], dR, filtR[[s]],
                   minOverlap = 12, maxMismatch = 0)
  saveRDS(list(merged   = mg,
               denoised = sum(getUniques(dF)),
               nmerged  = sum(mg$abundance)), f)
  rm(dF, dR, mg); gc()
}
```

## 2.6 Sequence table, length filter, chimeras, read tracking

```{r sm-seqtab}
res <- lapply(setNames(sample.names, sample.names),
              function(s) readRDS(file.path(ckpt, paste0("merged_", s, ".rds"))))

seqtab <- makeSequenceTable(lapply(res, `[[`, "merged"))
saveRDS(seqtab, "SM_seqtab_byrun.rds")
dim(seqtab)
table(nchar(getSequences(seqtab)))

seqtab2 <- seqtab[, nchar(colnames(seqtab)) %in% 245:265]
seqtab.nochim <- removeBimeraDenovo(seqtab2, method = "consensus",
                                    multithread = TRUE, verbose = TRUE)
dim(seqtab.nochim)
sum(seqtab.nochim) / sum(seqtab2)
saveRDS(seqtab.nochim, "SM_seqtab.nochim_byrun.rds")

trk <- data.frame(run      = run[sample.names],
                  input    = outsm[sample.names, 1],
                  filtered = outsm[sample.names, 2],
                  denoised = sapply(res, `[[`, "denoised"),
                  merged   = sapply(res, `[[`, "nmerged"),
                  tabled   = rowSums(seqtab2)[sample.names],
                  nonchim  = rowSums(seqtab.nochim)[sample.names],
                  row.names = sample.names)
trk$merge_rate <- trk$merged / trk$denoised
trk$kept       <- trk$nonchim / trk$input
write.csv(trk, "SM_16S_readstats_byrun.csv")
print(aggregate(cbind(kept, merge_rate) ~ run, data = trk, FUN = mean))
print(head(trk[order(trk$merge_rate), ], 10))   # lowest merge rates

rm(res, seqtab, seqtab2); gc()
```

## 2.7 Taxonomy in chunks of 2,000 ASVs (resumable)

```{r sm-taxa}
seqs   <- colnames(seqtab.nochim)
chunks <- split(seqs, ceiling(seq_along(seqs) / 2000))
for (k in seq_along(chunks)) {
  f <- file.path(ckpt, paste0("taxa_chunk_", k, ".rds"))
  if (file.exists(f)) next
  message("Taxonomy chunk ", k, " of ", length(chunks))
  set.seed(100)
  saveRDS(assignTaxonomy(chunks[[k]], silva, multithread = TRUE), f)
  gc()
}
taxa <- do.call(rbind, lapply(seq_along(chunks), function(k)
  readRDS(file.path(ckpt, paste0("taxa_chunk_", k, ".rds")))))
stopifnot(identical(rownames(taxa), seqs))
saveRDS(taxa, "SM_16S_taxa_byrun.rds")
```

## 2.8 Phyloseq, cleaning, decontam

Decontam uses `batch = "Run"`, so each run is checked against its own negative.

```{r sm-phyloseq}
samdf <- read.csv(samdf_file)
samdf[] <- lapply(samdf, function(x) if (is.character(x)) trimws(x) else x)
rownames(samdf) <- samdf$Sample.ID
samdf$Run <- run[rownames(samdf)]
stopifnot(setequal(rownames(samdf), rownames(seqtab.nochim)))
print(table(samdf$Month, samdf$Run, useNA = "ifany"))

ids   <- paste0("sq", seq_len(ncol(seqtab.nochim)))
taxa2 <- cbind(taxa, Sequence = rownames(taxa))
colnames(seqtab.nochim) <- ids
rownames(taxa2) <- ids

ps.sm <- phyloseq(otu_table(seqtab.nochim, taxa_are_rows = FALSE),
                  sample_data(samdf), tax_table(taxa2))
saveRDS(ps.sm, "sm.ps.byrun.raw.rds")

ps.sm <- subset_taxa(ps.sm, (Family != "Mitochondria") | is.na(Family))
ps.sm <- subset_taxa(ps.sm, (Order  != "Chloroplast")  | is.na(Order))
ps.sm <- subset_taxa(ps.sm, Kingdom == "Bacteria")

# Library sizes (negatives should be lowest)
df <- as.data.frame(sample_data(ps.sm))
df$LibrarySize <- sample_sums(ps.sm)
df <- df[order(df$LibrarySize), ]; df$Index <- seq(nrow(df))
ggplot(df, aes(Index, LibrarySize, color = Month, shape = Run)) + geom_point()

negs.sm <- c("MM_NEG_F4", "MM_NEG_H12")
sample_data(ps.sm)$is.neg <- sample_names(ps.sm) %in% negs.sm
contam.sm <- isContaminant(ps.sm, method = "prevalence", neg = "is.neg",
                           batch = "Run", threshold = 0.5)
print(table(contam.sm$contaminant))

ps.sm <- prune_taxa(!contam.sm$contaminant, ps.sm)
ps.sm <- prune_samples(!(sample_names(ps.sm) %in% negs.sm), ps.sm)
ps.sm <- prune_taxa(taxa_sums(ps.sm) > 0, ps.sm)
ps.sm
saveRDS(ps.sm, "sm.ps.cleaner.byrun.rds")   # USED FOR STATS
```

# 3. Diel

## 3.1 Files, filtN, primer check, quality profiles

```{r diel-filtN}
fnFsdi <- sort(list.files(diel_path, pattern = "_R1_16S_final.fastq", full.names = TRUE))
fnRsdi <- sort(list.files(diel_path, pattern = "_R2_16S_final.fastq", full.names = TRUE))
sample.namesdi <- sapply(strsplit(basename(fnFsdi), "_R1_"), `[`, 1)
length(fnFsdi)                              # want 36

fnFsdi.filtN <- file.path(diel_path, "filtN", basename(fnFsdi))
fnRsdi.filtN <- file.path(diel_path, "filtN", basename(fnRsdi))
for (i in seq(1, length(fnFsdi), by = 5)) {
  inds <- i:min(i + 4, length(fnFsdi))
  filterAndTrim(fnFsdi[inds], fnFsdi.filtN[inds], fnRsdi[inds], fnRsdi.filtN[inds],
                maxN = 0, multithread = TRUE, compress = TRUE)
}

primerTable(fnFsdi.filtN[[4]], fnRsdi.filtN[[4]])     # all 0: no primers

plotQualityGroups(fnFsdi.filtN)
plotQualityGroups(fnRsdi.filtN)
# truncLen = c(220, 220)
```

## 3.2 Filter and trim

```{r diel-trim}
filtFsdi <- file.path(diel_path, "trimmed", paste0(sample.namesdi, "_F_filt.fastq.gz"))
filtRsdi <- file.path(diel_path, "trimmed", paste0(sample.namesdi, "_R_filt.fastq.gz"))

outdi <- data.frame()
for (i in seq(1, length(fnFsdi), by = 5)) {
  inds <- i:min(i + 4, length(fnFsdi))
  outdi <- rbind(outdi, filterAndTrim(fnFsdi[inds], filtFsdi[inds],
                                      fnRsdi[inds], filtRsdi[inds],
                                      truncLen = c(220, 220), maxN = 0,
                                      maxEE = c(2, 2), truncQ = 2,
                                      rm.phix = TRUE, matchIDs = TRUE,
                                      compress = TRUE, multithread = TRUE))
}
write.csv(outdi, "outdi.csv", row.names = TRUE, quote = FALSE)
```

## 3.3 Error rates

```{r diel-errors}
errFdi <- learnErrors(filtFsdi, multithread = TRUE)
errRdi <- learnErrors(filtRsdi, multithread = TRUE)
saveRDS(errFdi, "errFdi.rds"); saveRDS(errRdi, "errRdi.rds")
plotErrors(errFdi, nominalQ = TRUE)
plotErrors(errRdi, nominalQ = TRUE)
```

## 3.4 Dereplicate, denoise, merge (run on the cluster for memory)

```{r diel-dada}
derepFsdi <- derepFastq(filtFsdi, verbose = TRUE)
derepRsdi <- derepFastq(filtRsdi, verbose = TRUE)
names(derepFsdi) <- sample.namesdi
names(derepRsdi) <- sample.namesdi

dadaFsdi <- dada(derepFsdi, err = errFdi, multithread = TRUE)
dadaRsdi <- dada(derepRsdi, err = errRdi, multithread = TRUE)
saveRDS(dadaFsdi, "dadaFsdi.rds"); saveRDS(dadaRsdi, "dadaRsdi.rds")

mergers2 <- mergePairs(dadaFsdi, derepFsdi, dadaRsdi, derepRsdi,
                       minOverlap = 12, maxMismatch = 0, verbose = TRUE)
```

## 3.5 Sequence table, length filter, chimeras, read tracking

```{r diel-seqtab}
seqtabdi <- makeSequenceTable(mergers2)
dim(seqtabdi)                               # previous run: 36 x 13695
saveRDS(seqtabdi, "seqtab_DIEL_16S.rds")
table(nchar(getSequences(seqtabdi)))

seqtab2di <- seqtabdi[, nchar(colnames(seqtabdi)) %in% 245:265]
saveRDS(seqtab2di, "seqtab2_DIEL_16S.rds")

seqtab.nochimdi <- removeBimeraDenovo(seqtab2di, method = "consensus",
                                      multithread = TRUE, verbose = TRUE)
dim(seqtab.nochimdi)                        # previous run: 36 x 12392
sum(seqtab.nochimdi) / sum(seqtab2di)       # previous run: 0.960
saveRDS(seqtab.nochimdi, "seqtab.nochim_DIEL_16S.rds")

trackdi <- cbind(outdi, sapply(dadaFsdi, getN), sapply(mergers2, getN),
                 rowSums(seqtab2di), rowSums(seqtab.nochimdi))
colnames(trackdi) <- c("input", "filtered", "denoised", "merged", "tabled", "nonchim")
rownames(trackdi) <- sample.namesdi
write.csv(trackdi, "DIEL_16S_readstats.csv", row.names = TRUE, quote = FALSE)
```

## 3.6 Taxonomy

```{r diel-taxa}
taxadi <- assignTaxonomy(seqtab.nochimdi, silva, multithread = TRUE)
saveRDS(taxadi, "DIEL_16S_taxa.rds")
```

## 3.7 Phyloseq, cleaning, decontam

```{r diel-phyloseq}
samdfdi <- read.csv("DIEL_SAMDF.csv")
samdfdi[] <- lapply(samdfdi, function(x) if (is.character(x)) trimws(x) else x)
rownames(samdfdi) <- samdfdi$Sample.ID
stopifnot(setequal(rownames(samdfdi), rownames(seqtab.nochimdi)))

idsdi   <- paste0("sq", seq_len(ncol(seqtab.nochimdi)))
taxa2di <- cbind(taxadi, Sequence = rownames(taxadi))
colnames(seqtab.nochimdi) <- idsdi
rownames(taxa2di) <- idsdi

psdi <- phyloseq(otu_table(seqtab.nochimdi, taxa_are_rows = FALSE),
                 sample_data(samdfdi), tax_table(taxa2di))
saveRDS(psdi, "ps.diel.update.rds")

ps.clean.DI <- subset_taxa(psdi, (Family != "Mitochondria") | is.na(Family))
ps.clean.DI <- subset_taxa(ps.clean.DI, (Order != "Chloroplast") | is.na(Order))
ps.clean.DI <- subset_taxa(ps.clean.DI, Kingdom == "Bacteria")
saveRDS(ps.clean.DI, "diel.psclean.rds")

# Library sizes
df <- as.data.frame(sample_data(ps.clean.DI))
df$LibrarySize <- sample_sums(ps.clean.DI)
df <- df[order(df$LibrarySize), ]; df$Index <- seq(nrow(df))
ggplot(df, aes(Index, LibrarySize, color = Diel_Time)) + geom_point()

# Decontam (negative control = MM_NEG_F4)
sample_data(ps.clean.DI)$is.neg <- sample_names(ps.clean.DI) == "MM_NEG_F4"
contamdi <- isContaminant(ps.clean.DI, method = "prevalence",
                          neg = "is.neg", threshold = 0.5)
table(contamdi$contaminant)                 # previous run: 5 contaminants

ps.cleaner.diel <- prune_taxa(!contamdi$contaminant, ps.clean.DI)
ps.cleaner.diel <- prune_samples(sample_names(ps.cleaner.diel) != "MM_NEG_F4",
                                 ps.cleaner.diel)
ps.cleaner.diel                             # previous run: 11007 taxa, 35 samples
saveRDS(ps.cleaner.diel, "diel.ps.cleaner.rds")   # USED FOR STATS
```
